marta: Heads-up: customer 'NobleMaps' is hitting 429s during CI prefetch. They enabled prefetch in our JS SDK and run ~60 concurrent runners.

jay: At deploy start or later?

marta: Deploy start. CI log: ```[INFO] prefetch token request
[WARN] 429 Too Many Requests - /v1/ephemeral_tokens (x7)
[DEBUG] retry in 120ms
[ERROR] retries exhausted```

emily: Sounds like a stampede. Do they use the default prefetch behavior?

marta: Yes, default. They turned prefetch on to reduce cold-start latency.

jay: Short term: request infra to allow a temporary tenant burst; client-side: add single-flight token fetch + jitter; fallback: flip prefetch off and do staged deploy. Which do they prefer?

marta: They want minimal failed jobs. Please open a burst request and send a quick SDK patch.

ratebot: [alert] tenant noblemaps ephemeral_token rate spike detected: 13x baseline. Auto-throttle applied.

jay: Opening BR. Request 4x burst for 10 minutes. Tagging infra-oncall.

jay: BR-12011 opened.

infra-oncall: Acknowledge. We can carve a tenant exception for 10 minutes. Applied if needed.

emily: Small client snippet to avoid parallel fetches: ```js
let pending=null; async function getEphemeral(){ if(pending) return pending; pending=(async()=>{ for(let i=0;i<6;i++){ try{ return await fetchToken(); }catch(e){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, Math.floor(Math.random()*250)+(2**i)*90)); }} throw new Error('token fetch failed'); })(); try{return await pending;}finally{ pending=null; }}
```

marta: Sending snippet + instruction to stagger runner start times (hash build id mod numRunners). Asking them to redeploy with burst window.

ratebot: [update] BR-12011 applied: tenant noblemaps ephemeral_token limit bumped x4 for 10m.

emily: Ops note: we should add a "staggered prefetch" option in the SDK and consider returning Retry-After with small jitter from ephemeral endpoint to discourage synchronized retries. I'll file an RFC.

jay: Also capture this as a CS playbook entry "ephemeral prefetch stampede" with mitigation checklist. Marta, can you draft after this?

marta: Yep, will add to onboarding runbook and include their CI config + short postmortem. Will update here after redeploy. :thumbsup:
